reason: £24.99 for one month of magnesium is about five times what Boots charges for a tub, and I only pay full price when I have to. I'd join the free waitlist to see whether the Founding 500 discount and the first-jar guarantee are as good as they sound.
objection: Why pay this much for gummies that contain sugar and glucose syrup when a Boots 3-for-2 gets me magnesium for a few pounds a pot? I can't tell from this page whether 180mg from citrate is any better than the cheap stuff.
would_change_my_mind: A first jar at a clearly lower price, or an independent test showing the magnesium in the jar matches the label.
